transcript: Speaker A: Teacher ne bola ghar mein English mein baat karo. Bacche se main kya baat karu? Mujhe toh apna naam bhi English mein likhna nahi aata. [Teacher said to speak in English at home. What should I talk to my child? I don't even know how to write my name in English.] Speaker B: Dekhiye aapko poori English nahi aani chahiye. Aapko itni aani chahiye ki bete ka homework samajh aaye, teacher se baat ho sake, school ka letter padh sako. [Look, you don't need to know full English. You just need to know enough to understand your son's homework, talk to the teacher, and read school letters.] Speaker A: Par main toh padhi likhi nahi hoon, mujhse hoga? [But I am not educated, will I be able to do it?] Speaker B: Bilkul hoga. English Seekho app mein General English show hai. Sab kuch Hindi mein samjhaya hai. Padhnah nahi hai, sirf video dekhna hai aur sunna hai. Hello se baat shuru karein. Pehla video hai, 1 lakh se zyada log dekh chuke hain. [Absolutely. There is a General English show in the English Seekho app. Everything is explained in Hindi. You don't have to read, just watch the video and listen. Start talking with Hello. It's the first video, more than 1 lakh people have watched it.] Speaker A: Par school mein toh bahut mushkil English hoti hai na? [But English in school is very difficult, right?] Speaker B: Aapko school wali English nahi seekhni. Pehle basic seekho. Roz ke 10 easy sentences. Roz ke chote sentences. "My name is Savitri", "My son studies in class 1". Itna kaafi hai shuru karne ke liye. [You don't need to learn school-level English. First learn basics. 10 easy sentences daily. Daily short sentences. "My name is Savitri", "My son studies in class 1". This is enough to start.] Speaker A: Aur bete ko kaise help karungi homework mein? [And how will I help my son with homework?] Speaker B: Good manners ke English words video hai please, thank you, sorry. Yeh words bete ke school mein bhi hain. Dono saath mein dekho. Bete ko lagega mummy bhi seekh rahi hai, woh aur motivate hoga. [There is a video on English words for good manners like please, thank you, sorry. These words are also in your son's school. Watch together. Your son will feel mummy is also learning, he will be more motivated.] Speaker A: Mujhe sharam aati hai, itni badi hoke basic English seekh rahi hoon. [I feel ashamed, learning basic English at this age.] Speaker B: App mein koi nahi dekh raha, koi judge nahi karega. Aur AI coach hai, 24 ghante available. Aap se Hindi mein baat karke English sikhayegi. 500 baar galat bolo, 500 baar sudharegi. Kabhi nahi bolegi ki padhi likhi nahi ho, tujhse nahi hoga. [No one is watching in the app, no one will judge. And there is an AI coach, available 24 hours. She will talk to you in Hindi and teach you English. Speak wrong 500 times, she will correct you 500 times. She will never say you are uneducated, you can't do it.] Speaker A: Sach mein kar paungi? [Will I really be able to do it?] Speaker B: Ek mahine mein aap bete ka homework samajh paogi, teacher se do line English mein bol paogi. PTM mein chup nahi baithogi. English Seekho app download karo, General English show kholo, aaj se shuru karo bete ke liye. [In one month, you will understand your son's homework, speak two lines in English with the teacher. You won't sit silent in PTM. Download English Seekho app, open General English show, start today for your son.] Speaker C: Toh install button pe click karo aur English Seekho app download karo. [So click on the install button and download the English Seekho app.]

summary: A mother shares her anxiety about not knowing English to help her son with schoolwork. An AI avatar reassures her and introduces the 'English Seekho' app, which offers simple Hindi-explained lessons and a supportive AI coach. The ad encourages parents to download the app to confidently participate in their child's education.
